license.notice: The Khronos glTF-Validator is invoked as a separate process for export validation. Its binary and sources are not bundled, vendored, or redistributed by Asset Mania.

acquisition.network_boundary: Acquisition happens before the network-deny boundary. No Asset Mania stage downloads the validator.
acquisition.official_archives_note: No release, revision, URL, or SHA-256 is recorded because none has been fetched and verified. Task 9 consumes this tool and must pin an exact release with its digest first; until then GLB validation reports an unvalidated profile rather than a passing one.
